title: Compact observability slate for integrations onboarding
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Summary:
Design and deliver a compact, integration-focused slate of observability screenshots and annotated assets for the onboarding/quickstart flow. This slate will be used across the console onboarding carousel, docs quickstart, and partner integration guides. The intent is to show immediate value: latency distribution, cost-per-token breakdown, and a short trace view for a single request path.

Goals:
- Produce a small set (6–8) of high-fidelity screenshots optimized for in-doc and in-console use.
- Keep visuals compact and scannable for first-run users integrating Redwood with their service.
- Provide annotation overlays and short copy snippets for each image so engineers/docs can drop them into the quickstart without additional edits.

Deliverables (high level):
- 1: Compact latency overview tile (percentiles + p95 callout) — desktop + mobile crop
- 1: Cost per token breakdown card (per-route token and aggregate) — with delta vs baseline
- 1: Micro-trace screenshot (single request timeline, service spans collapsed to 3 lines)
- 1: Combined snapshot showing latency + cost inline for a single request (for partner docs)
- 2–4 annotation PNGs (transparent overlays) and an editable Figma file with components and layout variants
- Copy snippets (15–35 words) for each image and alt text for accessibility
- Image export batch: 1440x900, 1024x576 (docs), 640x360 (mobile preview)

Visual & annotation specs:
- Use console color tokens: --rf-blue-500 for highlights, --rf-gray-50 background, --rf-yellow-400 alerts
- P95 latency highlighted with a badge and tooltip pointer (badge copy: "p95: 180 ms")
- Cost-per-token table to show: model, avg tokens/req, tokens/day, cost/day — highlight model differences with color striping
- Traces: collapse long spans, show service icons (gateway, runtime, cache) and duration bars scaled to 250px max width
- All overlays exported as 2x PNGs and one SVG for docs that need scaling

Copy and microcopy (drafts):
- Latency tile headline: "Latency snapshot — per-route p50/p95"
- Cost tile headline: "Token cost — per-request and daily estimate"
- Trace caption: "Quick trace — request path and service durations"
- Alt text examples included in the asset folder

Acceptance criteria:
- Screenshots match console theme and pass visual QA (no text truncation, legible at smallest export)
- Annotations align to UI components in the latest runtime-1.18 console build (ENG-4889)
- Figma file contains named frames and export presets for all three sizes
- Accessibility: all images have alt text and a short plain-text caption
- Docs team has approved the copy: see PM review entry below

Dependencies & links:
- Figma master file (working): https://www.figma.com/file/Redwood/observability-onboard-compact-slate (working file)
- Confluence PRD: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/Observability+Onboarding+PRD (reference)
- GitHub PR for console screenshot CSS changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/6723

Progress updates and decisions (chronological):
- 2025-02-12 (Ava Chen): Ticket created; initial exploration frames sketched in Figma. Decided to prioritize compact widths that match embed sizes used in partner docs.
- 2025-02-18 (Rafael Gomez): Early mock uploaded to Figma frame "compact-tiles/v1". Chose to collapse trace spans to 3 rows to keep height under 220px.
- 2025-02-22 (PM review by L. Patel): PM requested an explicit cost delta vs baseline (baseline = small model quantized) added to the cost card. Marked candidate copy for review.
- 2025-02-25 (Design review session): Engineering feedback (ENG-4889) — rendering of small charts requires 2x pixel-perfect assets; agreed to export PNG@2x + SVG. Rafael to run visual QA after styling update in PR #6723.
- 2025-03-01 (Rafael Gomez): First export batch attached to Figma. Upload to drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/observability-assets-DES-60123 (private link). Requested docs review.
- 2025-03-03 (Docs feedback by J. Nguyen): Minor copy tweaks: replace "daily estimate" -> "approx. daily cost"; request alt text variations for screen readers. Rafael updated asset layer names.

Review feedback & follow-ups:
- PM (L. Patel): Approved final visuals pending one small color contrast tweak on the cost delta chip.
- Eng (S. Ortiz): Verified images render correctly in the console iframe; suggested adding a 1px subtle divider in the combined snapshot to separate latency from cost.
- Docs (J. Nguyen): Approved copy with the alt text change; asked that we place the mobile crops into the docs repo under docs/assets/observability/quickstart/

Open questions / trade-offs considered:
- Trade-off: more detailed trace (full span hierarchy) vs compactness for onboarding. Decision: compact trace wins for first-run; link to full trace in docs for advanced debugging.
- Trade-off: include numeric table for token cost vs a small bar chart. Decision: include both in the combined snapshot (table collapsed at small sizes).

Next steps (short):
- Rafael: push final export set and clean Figma file (by 2025-03-05).
- Eng: merge console PR for CSS export tweaks (PR #6723) and confirm no pixel shift (target 2025-03-07).
- Docs: pick final images and update quickstart markdown and partner guide snippets (assigned: J. Nguyen).

Artifact links (final):
- Figma final frame names: compact-tiles/v2, compact-trace/v2, combined-snapshot/v2
- Drive export folder (final): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/observability-assets-DES-60123
- Console PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/6723
- Docs PR placeholder: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1182

Notes for handoff:
- Include a "how to crop" sheet inside the Figma file with exact x/y crop guides for each export size.
- Provide raw SVGs and 2x PNGs so engineers can pick the right asset for retina displays.
- Keep copy locked in the Figma component token named "OBS-COPY-LOCK" to avoid drift after handoff.

Comments (recent):
- 2025-03-03 (Rafael Gomez): "Uploaded v2 exports to Drive and adjusted cost chip color to match contrast guidance. File names end in _v2_1440x900.png. Waiting for ENG PR to land before final tagging."
- 2025-03-03 (L. Patel): "Thanks — will queue these for the documentation deploy on 2025-03-11. Please add alt text variants for screen readers to the asset manifest."

Acceptance checklist (for marking Done):
- [ ] Final PNG and SVG assets exported and uploaded to Drive
- [ ] Figma file cleaned and frames named
- [ ] Copy approved by Docs and PM
- [ ] Console CSS PR merged and visual QA passed
- [ ] Docs PR updated with new images and scheduled for 2025-03-11 deploy

If anything blocks progress, comment here and tag @engineering-runbooks or add ENG-4889 to dependencies.
